summary.name: AlDente and Leftovers
summary.one_liner: AppHouseKitchen's site for two macOS utilities: AlDente, which sets a MacBook battery charge limit, and Leftovers, which automatically sorts and cleans up the Downloads folder.
use_cases: Limit MacBook charge to around 80% to reduce battery wear
Automatically sort new downloads on a Mac
Monitor and calibrate MacBook battery health
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes two macOS utilities from AppHouseKitchen. AlDente lets users set a MacBook charge limit so the battery spends less time fully charged, with features named as Heat Protection, Sailing Mode, Calibration Mode and scheduling. Leftovers catches new downloads as they arrive and sorts them, using Quick Access folders, swipe-to-sort, download reminders and AI-powered file suggestions. The page also lists a 'Snack Bar' newsletter for a product in development, news posts about AlDente (including macOS 26.4 battery charge limiter and analytics settings), and user reviews. It is a marketing site with limited technical detail.
notable: AlDente is listed in awesome-mac and marked open source via its GitHub repository (davidwernhart/AlDente)
AlDente is sold through Setapp, per the page
AlDente includes Heat Protection, Sailing Mode, and Calibration Mode
Leftovers uses AI-powered file suggestions for Downloads
caveats: Page does not state pricing for either app
Leftovers details are marketing-level with no stated limits
Page mentions 'Setapp' availability, which typically requires a subscription, but the page does not state the terms
